title: Ordinary adjunct formula for the total derived scalar limit
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme T, an ordinary tensor/limit model M of [def-trf-completion-unit-models], and a coefficient derived system calculus S of [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define a_Q as the ordinary constant/limit adjunct of the complexified M.adjunction unit, including the composite-functor comparison. Suppose c identifies termwise limit with roosLimitFunctor preserving ordinary projections, and eta is a natural map from the localized Roos complex to total derived limit such that Q(c) followed by eta is the universal derived-limit comparison. For a morphism f from S.reduction(Q(Q)) to Q(M.quotient(Q)), assume its S-adjunction transpose is the localized M-unit followed by systemLimitUnit(M,eta). Then S.unit followed by total derived limit of the restricted f and its exact localization factor equals localization of the ordinary constant/limit unit followed by termwise limit of a_Q, followed by the universal derived-limit comparison. No flatness or invertibility of f is needed.

proof.text: Construct a_Q explicitly with the inverse ordinary constant/limit Hom equivalence applied to M.adjunction.unit followed by the composite-functor comparison. Expand the given S-adjunction Hom equality using homEquiv_unit. Compose with the right-derived limit of the exact restriction localization factor; its inverse inside systemLimitUnit cancels. Ordinary limit projections identify M.limitComparison with the composite-functor comparison followed by c. The ordinary constant/limit Hom equivalence takes a_Q to that model unit. Finally substitute the assumed normalization of eta. This gives the claimed total derived-limit formula. For the canonical c and eta used in the parent, their normalization follows by unfolding the canonical eta, cancelling c with its inverse and retaining the universal localization comparison.

proof_origin.place: Tags 07A6 (adjunction), 0D6E (derived comparison) and 0941 (derived limit). Q8: cancellation of exact localization factors and ordinary adjunction identities.

theorem openDvrScalarUnitFormula (T : Scheme.{u})
    (S : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E T)
    (M : CompletionUnit.OrdinaryModel l E T)
    (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ)
    (c : (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ⥤ _).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ) ≅ roosLimitFunctor)
    (hc : ∀ (Z : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ)
      (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      (c.hom.app Z ≫ limit.π Z.asFunctor (op n)).f i = limit.π (Z.X i) (op n))
    (η : roosLimitFunctor ⋙
        (DerivedCategory.Q (C := scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T)) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.Q (C := ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T)) ⋙
        coefficientConstantTowerLimit.{u, u} l E T)
    (hη : ∀ Z : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ℤ,
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.hom.app Z) ≫ η.app Z =
        derivedLimitComplexComparison
          (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ⥤ _)
          (coefficientConstantTowerLimit.{u, u} l E T)
          (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ⥤ _).rightDerivedFunctorUnit Z)
    (f : S.reduction.obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ⟶
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj ((M.quotient l E T).obj Q))
    (he : S.adjunction.homEquiv _ _ f =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map ((M.adjunction.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app Q) ≫
        (CompletionUnit.systemLimitUnit l E T M
          η).app ((M.quotient l E T).obj Q)) :
    S.adjunction.unit.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫
        (coefficientConstantTowerLimit.{u, u} l E T).map
          ((coefficientSequenceDerivedRestriction.{u, u} l E T).map f ≫
            (Functor.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.{u+2, u+2, u+1, u+1, u+2, u+2}
              (coefficientSequenceRestriction.{u, u} l E T)).hom.app
                ((M.quotient l E T).obj Q)) =
      DerivedCategory.Q.map
        (((constLimAdj : (Functor.const ℕᵒᵖ : scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T ⥤ _) ⊣
          lim).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app Q ≫
            ((lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ⥤ _).mapHomologicalComplex
              (.up ℤ)).map (openScalarComplexAugmentation l E T M Q)) ≫
        derivedLimitComplexComparison
          (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ⥤ _)
          (coefficientConstantTowerLimit.{u, u} l E T)
          (lim : (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ scalarReductionSource.{u, u} l E T) ⥤ _).rightDerivedFunctorUnit
          ((CompletionUnit.tower l E T).obj ((M.quotient l E T).obj Q))
